customer: I just moved to Virginia and I'm trying to get out of the lease on my midsize SUV, but I keep getting the runaround. It's through Crescent Motor Credit. Can Northwind just buy out the lease or not?
agent: I'm sorry for the hassle, and I'll give you a straight answer: according to our article "Which leasing companies allow third-party buyouts," Crescent Motor Credit doesn't allow us to buy out the lease directly. The article "Selling vs. turning in at lease end" compares those two choices.
